messages.content: 紐約目前的交通狀況如何？

function.name: geocode_address
function.description: Transforms a description of a location (like a pair of coordinates, an address, or a name of a place) to a location on the Earth's surface. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

address.description: The address that needs to be geocoded.

locale.description: Preferred locale for the returned address information. (Optional) Default: None

message.reasoning:
The user asks "紐約目前的交通狀況如何？" which means "What is the current traffic situation in New York?" They want real-time traffic data. We need to use the geocode_address function to get the location of New York. Then we can provide traffic info. But we don't have direct traffic data. We might need to call some API. However, the only tool available is geocode_address. That gives us coordinates. But no traffic data. So we cannot answer with real-time traffic. We should explain that we can't fetch real-time traffic. Possibly we can give general advice. But the user specifically wants current traffic. We can say we don't have real-time data. We could suggest using Google Maps or Waze. But we can also try to get the coordinates of New York City. Let's do that.

We will call geocode_address with address "New York City". Then we can respond that we don't have real-time traffic data.
